channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 5 Oct: Harare light drizzle · high 23° / low 14°
item.description: Harare: high 23°, low 14° (light drizzle) · Bulawayo: high 24°, low 13° (showers) · Mutare: high 25°, low 15° (light showers) · Gweru: high 26°, low 12° (thunderstorm) · Masvingo: high 26°, low 15° (light showers) · Victoria Falls: high 33°, low 19° (heavy showers) Tsumo yezuva: Imbwa nyoro ndidzo tsengi dzamatovo.
